user_message_formats.extraction_stage1: PROJECT <jur>, DOCUMENT <n> [<doc_id>] ... followed by the page-delimited text (=== DOC n PAGE p ===)
user_message_formats.extraction_stage2_synthesis: document list (doc, doc_id, title, year, kind, staff flag) + JSON array of stage-1 findings
user_message_formats.extraction_single:
PROJECT <jur>

DOCUMENTS:
<list>

########## DOCUMENT n [doc_id] ########## + page-delimited texts of all core documents
user_message_formats.endorsement_census: same as extraction_single (all core documents of one project)
user_message_formats.posture_survey: PROJECT <jur>, DOCUMENT <n> [<doc_id>], year, kind, lang + page-delimited text of one document

provider_settings.anthropic: messages.stream, max_tokens per stage (32000 extraction, 4000 census, 16000-40000 survey); temperature not settable

note: Every real run also archives the exact request text (requests/*.txt.gz) and the response; these exports are the rendered prompts for reading and for re-running elsewhere.
